arxiv-1912-08567.title: Teaching Design of Experiments using Hasse diagrams
arxiv-1912-08567.creator: Hans-Michael Kaltenbach
arxiv-1912-08567.description: Abstract Hasse diagrams provide a principled means for visualizing the structure of statistical designs constructed by crossing and nesting of experimental factors. They have long been applied for automated construction of linear models and their associated linear subspaces for complex designs.

arxiv-2011-09383.title: About penalty-duality methods in fluid-structure interactions
arxiv-2011-09383.creator: Philippe Destuynder, Erwan Liberge
arxiv-2011-09383.description: Abstract In fluid-structure interaction problems, some people use a penalty method for positioning the structure inside the fluid. This is usually performed by considering that the fluid is very stiff or/and very heavy at the place occupied by the structure. These methods are very convenient for the programming point of view but lead to ill conditioned operators.

arxiv-2105-01815.title: Vulnerability of Blockchain Technologies to Quantum Attacks
arxiv-2105-01815.creator: Joseph J. Kearney, Carlos A. Perez-Delgado
arxiv-2105-01815.description: Abstract Quantum computation represents a threat to many cryptographic protocols in operation today. It has been estimated that by 2035, there will exist a quantum computer capable of breaking the vital cryptographic scheme RSA2048. Blockchain technologies rely on cryptographic protocols for many of their essential sub-routines. Some of these protocols, but not all, are open to quantum attacks.

arxiv-2206-14578.title: Evaluating Generative Patent Language Models
arxiv-2206-14578.creator: Jieh-Sheng Lee
arxiv-2206-14578.description: Abstract Generative language models are promising for assisting human writing in various domains. This manuscript aims to build generative language models in the patent domain and evaluate model performance from a human-centric perspective. The perspective is to measure the ratio of keystrokes that can be saved by autocompletion based on generative patent language models.

arxiv-2208-13357.title: Application of Ramsey theory to localization of set of product states via multicopies
arxiv-2208-13357.creator: Xing-Chen Guo, Mao-Sheng Li
arxiv-2208-13357.description: Abstract It is well known that any N N orthogonal pure states can always be perfectly distinguished under local operation and classical communications (LOCC) if ( N − 1 ) (N-1) copies of the state are available [ Phys. Rev. Lett. 85 , 4972 (2000) ].

arxiv-2306-01803.title: The central dogma of biological homochirality: How does chiral information propagate in a prebiotic network?
arxiv-2306-01803.creator: S. Furkan Ozturk, Dimitar D. Sasselov, John D. Sutherland
arxiv-2306-01803.description: Abstract Biological systems are homochiral, raising the question of how a racemic mixture of prebiotically synthesized biomolecules could attain a homochiral state at the network level. Based on our recent results, we aim to address a related question of how chiral information might have flowed in a prebiotic network.

arxiv-2307-08085.title: MindOpt Tuner: Boost the Performance of Numerical Software by Automatic Parameter Tuning
arxiv-2307-08085.creator: Mengyuan Zhang, Wotao Yin, Mengchang Wang, Yangbin Shen, Peng Xiang, You Wu, Liang Zhao, Junqiu Pan, Hu Jiang, KuoLing Huang
arxiv-2307-08085.description: Abstract Numerical software is usually shipped with built-in hyperparameters. By carefully tuning those hyperparameters, significant performance enhancements can be achieved for specific applications. We developed MindOpt Tuner, a new automatic tuning tool that supports a wide range of numerical software, including optimization and other solvers.

arxiv-2309-07385.title: Multi-dimensional Speech Quality Assessment in Crowdsourcing
arxiv-2309-07385.creator: Babak Naderi, Ross Cutler, Nicolae-Cătălin Ristea
arxiv-2309-07385.description: Abstract Subjective speech quality assessment is the gold standard for evaluating speech enhancement processing and telecommunication systems. The commonly used standard ITU-T Rec. P.800 defines how to measure speech quality in lab environments, and ITU-T Rec. P.808 extended it for crowdsourcing. ITU-T Rec. P.835 extends P.800 to measure the quality of speech in the presence of noise. ITU-T Rec. P.

arxiv-2309-15391.title: A Risk-Ratio-Based Marginal Sensitivity Model for Causal Effects in Observational Studies
arxiv-2309-15391.creator: MD ABDUL BASIT, MAHBUB AHM LATIF, ABDUS S. WAHED
arxiv-2309-15391.description: Abstract In observational studies, the identification of causal estimands depends on the no unmeasured confounding (NUC) assumption. As this assumption is not testable from observed data, sensitivity analysis plays an important role in observational studies to investigate the impact of unmeasured confounding on the causal conclusions.

arxiv-2405-15143.title: Intelligent Go-Explore: Standing on the Shoulders of Giant Foundation Models
arxiv-2405-15143.creator: Cong Lu, Shengran Hu, Jeff Clune
arxiv-2405-15143.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Cong Lu, Shengran Hu, Jeff Clune. Go-Explore is a powerful family of algorithms designed to solve hard-exploration problems built on the principle of archiving discovered states, and iteratively returning to and exploring from the most promising states.

arxiv-2408-14923.title: Unraveling the Airalo Ecosystem CCS: Networks Network measurement CCS: Networks Network performance analysis CCS: Networks Topology analysis and generation CCS: Networks Network economics CCS: Networks Location based services
arxiv-2408-14923.creator: HyunSeok (Daniel) Jang, Matteo Varvello, Andra Lutu, Yasir Zaki
arxiv-2408-14923.description: Abstract . In recent years, we have witnessed myriad flavours of Mobile Network Aggregators (MNAs) which exploit the coverage footprint of a handful of base operators to provide global mobile connectivity. Under the MNA model, emerging operators reap the benefits of network softwarization and virtualization, including eSIM technology or control/data-plane separation.

arxiv-2410-17507.title: Detecting fake review buyers using network structure: Direct evidence from Amazon DOI: https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.2211932119
arxiv-2410-17507.creator: Sherry He, Brett Hollenbeck, Gijs Overgoor, Davide Proserpio, Ali Tosyali
arxiv-2410-17507.description: Abstract Online reviews significantly impact consumers’ decision-making process and firms’ economic outcomes and are widely seen as crucial to the success of online markets. Firms, therefore, have a strong incentive to manipulate ratings using fake reviews. This presents a problem that academic researchers have tried to solve over two decades and on which platforms expend a large amount of resources.

arxiv-2503-20218.title: Video Motion Graphs
arxiv-2503-20218.creator: Haiyang Liu, Zhan Xu, Fa-Ting Hong, Hsin-Ping Huang, Yi Zhou, Yang Zhou
arxiv-2503-20218.description: Abstract We present Video Motion Graphs , a system designed to generate realistic human motion videos. Using a reference video and conditional signals such as music or motion tags, the system synthesizes new videos by first retrieving video clips with gestures matching the conditions and then generating interpolation frames to seamlessly connect clip boundaries.

arxiv-2505-15032.title: Orthogonal Arrays: A Review
arxiv-2505-15032.creator: C. Devon Lin, John Stufken
arxiv-2505-15032.description: Abstract Orthogonal arrays are arguably one of the most fascinating and important statistical tools for efficient data collection. They have a simple, natural definition, desirable properties when used as fractional factorials, and a rich and beautiful mathematical theory. Their connections with combinatorics, finite fields, geometry, and error-correcting codes are profound.

arxiv-2509-11164.title: No Mesh, No Problem: Estimating Coral Volume and Surface from Sparse Multi-View Images
arxiv-2509-11164.creator: Diego E. Farchione, Ramzi Idoughi, Peter Wonka
arxiv-2509-11164.description: Abstract Effective reef monitoring requires the quantification of coral growth via accurate volumetric and surface area estimates, which is a challenging task due to the complex morphology of corals. We propose a novel, lightweight, and scalable learning framework that addresses this challenge by predicting the 3D volume and surface area of coral-like objects from 2D multi-view RGB images.

During bacterial growth and division, there is a constant balance...

pmc-11355645.title: Advancing the Diagnosis of Diabetic Neuropathies: Electrodiagnostic and Skin Autofluorescence Methods
pmc-11355645.creator: Dan Trofin, Bianca-Margareta Salmen, Teodor Salmen, Daniela Marilena Trofin, Delia Reurean-Pintilei, Takaaki Senbonmatsu, Makoto Katoh
pmc-11355645.description: Introduction: Diabetic neuropathy (DN) is a generic term for various neuropathies coexisting in a single patient. Clinical diagnosis alone can be misleading, yet routine electrodiagnostic studies in diabetes care are rare. Skin autofluorescence (SAF) is a recognized DN risk factor with potential screening value.

pmc-11727082.title: IL-4R and CXCR2 Contribute to Downregulating Neutrophil-Mediated Response in the Early Stage of Fungal Extract-Induced Allergic Airway Inflammation
pmc-11727082.creator: Marina A Shevchenko, Ekaterina A Servuli, Dina E Murova, Julia D Vavilova, Elena L Bolkhovitina, Ekaterina N Chursanova, Alexander M Sapozhnikov, Yoshitaka Hosokawa
pmc-11727082.description: Background/Objectives: Airborne exogenous antigen inhalation can induce neutrophil infiltration of the airways, while eosinophils migrate to the airways in allergic airway inflammation. During a bacterial infection, Th2-associated cytokine IL-4, by binding to the IL-4 receptor (IL-4R), can suppress neutrophil recruitment to the site of inflammation.

pmc-12506262.title: A case of renal diffuse large B-cell lymphoma concurrent with disseminated muscle involvement
pmc-12506262.creator: Taha Enes Cetin, Remzi Goktug Yahyaoglu, Irem Saribiyik, Onur Ertunc, Omer Faruk Akcay, Yasemin Erten
pmc-12506262.description: BackgroundRenal involvement in the diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) is rare and usually occurs as part of systemic disease. Muscle infiltration is even less common and can mimic inflammatory or obstructive conditions.Case presentationWe present a 58-year-old male with right flank pain, myalgia, oliguria, and weight loss.

pmc-12717886.title: Intramodal stimulated Brillouin scattering in suspended AlN waveguides
pmc-12717886.creator: Han Xue, Chukun Huang, Haotian Shi, Jiaheng Fu, Tianheng Zhang, Junqiang Sun
pmc-12717886.description: Aluminum nitride (AlN), a wide-bandgap III–V material, offers excellent transparency in the optical communication band and a favorable refractive index for strong optical confinement, making it a promising platform in stimulated Brillouin scattering (SBS). Here, we observe, for the first time, optically excited SBS in suspended AlN-on-silicon waveguides. A Brillouin gain coefficient of 91.

pmc-12735572.title: Haem Oxygenase-1, Ferroptosis and Disorders—A Narrative Review
pmc-12735572.creator: James Pham, Michel Refesse, Ashwa Saeed, Gladys O. Latunde-Dada
pmc-12735572.description: Ferroptosis is a non-apoptotic form of cell death that is driven by iron and reactive oxygen species (ROS). This process is characterised by lipid peroxidation, which damages cell membranes and distinguishes it from other types of cell death. Excess iron promotes ferroptosis through Fenton chemistry, leading to increased ROS production.

pmc-12736124.title: Dermal Formulation Incorporating Isoconazole Nitrate Nanoparticles Offers High Absorption into Skin and Antimicrobial Effect Against Candida albicans
pmc-12736124.creator: Ayako Harada, Rie Tanaka, Hiroko Otake, Masanori Yoshimura, Tae Wada, Tohru Nagahama, Noriaki Nagai
pmc-12736124.description: Background: Isoconazole nitrate (ISN), an antifungal agent that inhibits ergosterol synthesis by blocking lanosterol 14α-demethylation, is widely used to treat candidiasis, and improving its skin retention and permeability can enhance its therapeutic efficacy. Therefore, we developed an ISN nanoparticle (ISN-NP) gel by wet-bead milling in the presence of methylcellulose (MC).

pmc-13376114.title: Air-Processed and Water-Stable Perovskite Solar Cells Enabled by a Fishing-Net-Inspired Interfacial Network
pmc-13376114.creator: Muh Fadhil Albab, Muhammad Jahandar, Ah Ra Kim, Jinhee Heo, Yong Hyun Kim, Youngkyoo Kim, Gi-Hwan Kim, Ji-Youn Seo, Shinuk Cho, Soyeon Kim, Dong Chan Lim
pmc-13376114.description: Highlights A metal-anchored molecular net interlayer strategy enables highly efficient inverted perovskite solar cells by optimizing interfacial energetics and charge transport.The metal–amine coordinated network provides a universal interfacial platform, regardless of bandgap or substrate, to suppress ion migration and prevent moisture-induced degradation.

pmc-13523929.title: Glycosylation in gut-brain communication: from the intestinal barrier and microbiota to immune and neural signaling
pmc-13523929.creator: Dan Wang, Dong Zhou, Jianguo Gu, Chao Huang, Wenting Zhang
pmc-13523929.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The gut-brain axis is a complex bidirectional communication network linking the gastrointestinal tract and the central nervous system. Its dysregulation is closely associated with a wide range of gastrointestinal, metabolic, and neuropsychiatric disorders. Glycosylation, one of the most prevalent and structurally diverse post-translational modifications of proteins and lipids, is increasingly recognized as a regulator of multiple processes within the gut-brain axis.

pmc-13579672.title: A cost-effectiveness analysis of selective decontamination of the digestive tract in mechanically ventilated patients in the intensive care unit
pmc-13579672.creator: Ashwani Kumar, Alamgir Kabir, John A Myburgh, Anthony Delaney, Simon Finfer, Naomi E Hammond, Sharon Micallef, Ian Seppelt, Balasubramanian Venkatesh, Colman Taylor, SuDDICU Australia Investigators and the Australian and New Zealand Intensive Care Society Clinical Trials Group
pmc-13579672.description: ObjectiveTo evaluate the 24-months cost-effectiveness of selective decontamination of the digestive tract (SDD) versus standard care in mechanically ventilated Intensive Care Unit (ICU) patients.DesignWithin‑trial cost‑effectiveness analysis using linked administrative healthcare datasets.SettingNineteen Australian ICUs participating in the Australian Selective Decontamination of the Digestive Tract in the ICU (SuDDICU Australia) cluster crossover randomised trial (2018–2021).
